definitions.explanation: A large, powerful mammal found in mountainous regions of Japan. Both brown bears (Hokkaido) and Asian black bears (Honshu) live in Japan.

notes:
{熊|くま} refers to bears.

Types in Japan:
- ⟦ヒグマ→ヒグマ：noentry⟧ (brown bear) - found in Hokkaido
- ⟦ツキノワグマ→ツキノワグマ：noentry⟧ (⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧{熊|ぐま}) - Asian black bear, found in Honshu/Shikoku

Safety note:
Bear encounters have increased in Japan as bears venture into residential areas seeking food. Hikers are advised to wear bells, make noise, and know how to respond to bear encounters. Warning signs ({熊|くま}⟦{出没|しゅつぼつ}→出没：28438_shutsubotsu⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧) are common on mountain trails.
